name: ENS documentation
summary: The ENS documentation, open source (CC0). It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads a documentation chatbot script from jsDelivr (@cookbookdev/docsbot) with no integrity hash, third-party code the user has not asked for. It also fetches the Solidity compiler list and loads Google Fonts.
